title: Extra More Blocks
description: More block shapes for vanilla blocks. Adds slabs, stairs, vertical slabs, doors, and trapdoors for glass, concrete, terracotta, and wool, plus vertical slabs for every slab in the game.
body:
Adds more block shapes for vanilla blocks. You get slabs, stairs, vertical slabs, doors, and trapdoors for glass, concrete, terracotta, and wool. Also adds vertical slabs for every slab in the game. Craft 3 blocks in a vertical column to get 6 vertical slabs, or use the stonecutter. Glass doors and trapdoors open by hand and sound like glass. Vertical slabs can be waterlogged.
